name: 46761 · Lagrange, IN
findings: ZIP 46761 (Lagrange) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46761 (Lagrange) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46761 (Lagrange) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).
